summary:
Chartered Accountant with 4+ years of post-qualification experience leading audits and ensuring compliance with
PCAOB/AICPA standards across the Asset & Wealth Management industry. Skilled in managing audit teams, executing
complex substantive testing, and delivering high-quality financial reporting and regulatory compliance. Proven track record of
working with global clients including BlackRock, driving efficiency and accuracy in audit engagements.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Excel→Microsoft Excel(100%), Word→Microsoft Word(100%), PowerPoint→Microsoft PowerPoint(100%))

bullets: Led end-to-end audits for public and non-public clients in the Asset & Wealth Management industry, ensuring compliance with PCAOB and AICPA standards.
Managed audit teams, reviewed work papers, and coordinated with clients and offshore teams to deliver timely, high- quality audit outcomes.
Executed substantive testing on statements of cash flows and schedules of investments at InHedge, including testing of ASC 815 derivative contracts.
Analyzed changes in unrealized appreciation/depreciation of financial instruments, performed investment manager report tie-outs, and validated realized gains and losses on derivatives.
At iShares, executed substantive testing across realized gain/loss, ASC 740 capital gains, affiliates, cross-trade transactions, bank confirmations, and income/expense areas.
Reviewed financial statements for accuracy and consistency; conducted N-1A testing including Prospectus, SAI, and Additional Disclosures for regulatory compliance.
Partnered with global clients including BlackRock iShares, Hedge Funds, Private Equity Funds, and Commodities Funds.
Prepared and submitted Income Tax Returns and assisted in preparation and filing of GST Returns for clients across varied business domains.
Conducted inventory audits comprising review of internal controls, physical verification, reconciliation with accounting records, and analysis of inventory ageing and scrutiny of inventory registers.
Assisted in finalization and closure of books of accounts for multiple clients.

entries.institution: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India
